lead.claim: ESWT offers short-term pain relief for chronic low back pain.
lead.context: *Why this matters:* A systematic review found radial extracorporeal shockwave therapy reduced pain but not functional disability in chronic low back pain.

supporting.claim: Meeting exercise guidelines improves processing speed and memory in MS.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: A systematic review found that meeting physical activity guidelines for people with MS significantly improved processing speed and visuospatial and verbal memory.

supporting.claim: Aquatic plyometrics better than land exercises for adolescent knee pain.
supporting.context: *Why this matters:* An RCT showed aquatic plyometric exercises improved pain, strength, function, and quality of life in adolescents with patellofemoral pain syndrome.

supporting.claim: Wearable ultrasound detects subtle knee neuromuscular coordination deficits.
supporting.context: *Why this matters:* A feasibility study found wearable ultrasound identified neuromuscular coordination differences after knee injury not seen with force plates.

supporting.claim: Balance confidence in older women links to activity and function.
supporting.context: *Why this matters:* A study found low balance confidence in older women correlated with more sitting and less function, while higher confidence linked to activity and better function.
